newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end down in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end down in technical correction.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Thursday in a technical correction after gains in the previous five sessions, brokers said.
The fall was partly broken, however, by continued gains in some mining stocks based on high international metal prices, they said.
The market could drop again Friday as there is still room for a further correction following the bull run, they added.
Thursday, the General Index .IGRA fell 0.66 percent to 1,708.81 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL dropped 1.05 percent to 2,469.41 points.
In a total of 1,236 trades, volume was 38.0 million soles ($14.3 million), according to preliminary figures.
"It is a simple correction and does not mean in any way there is not interset in the market," said Rolando Yale of local brokerage Rentaval
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru closed down 3.52 percent at 6.30 soles in modest volume of 688,000 shares.
